strategies.hypothesis: During the liquid New York morning, an objectively compressed M5 balance that breaks with strong range/body expansion in the direction of an already-established completed-M15 trend can continue after price retests and accepts the broken boundary, because the retest filters failed displacement and renewed impulse indicates directional liquidity consumption without chasing the first burst.
strategies.economic_rationale: Recurring New York liquidity arrival, clustered volatility, boundary order concentration, and staged large-order execution can repeatedly create balance-displacement-retest-continuation behavior. Waiting for renewed continuation seeks a larger structural measured move at low turnover, with at least 4 pips planned risk and 6 pips remaining reward against a frozen 1-pip stress cost.
strategies.date_provenance: Prospectively preregistered before implementation and before any Strategy 15 development backtest or result access.
frozen_rules: Use UTC M1 bid OHLCV and construct only M5/M15 bars having exactly 5/15 consecutive one-minute constituents; a higher-timeframe bar becomes usable only at its end instant.

Evaluate only on completion of a new M5 bar. For candidate expansion E, use the immediately prior 12 M5 bars as compression B and the immediately preceding 48 M5 bars as baseline A; all 61 bars must be consecutive.
Require compression median range <= the linearly interpolated 25th percentile of baseline ranges and a nonzero compression box width W <= 15 pips.
Use 24 completed M15 bars ending no later than E start. BUY context requires last close > current SMA20 > SMA20 lagged four M15 bars; SELL is the exact inverse.

E must start on Monday-Friday at 08:00 <= America/New_York local time < 11:30. Its range must be >= max(2 times compression median range, baseline range Q75), <= 3 times baseline median range, body/range >= 0.65, and close in the directional outer 20 percent.
E must clear the compression boundary by at least 0.5 pip but no more than 0.50 of W in the aligned direction.
The first retest R must occur one to three completed M5 bars after E. BUY low must be within [H-0.25W,H+0.20W] and close >= H; SELL is mirrored at L. A deeper intervening close invalidates the setup.

Confirmation C must be the first later qualifying bar, no later than E+4 and complete by 12:00 New York on E's local date. It must renew beyond E close and all pullback extremes by 0.2 pip, have aligned body, body/range >= 0.50, and close in the directional outer 25 percent.
No E-through-C candle may touch the structural target. BUY stop is min low from E+1 through C minus 0.5 pip and target is H+1.5W; SELL stop is max high plus 0.5 pip and target is L-1.5W.
At signal close and actual next-M1 open require stop distance >=4 pips, reward distance >=6 pips, (reward-1 pip)/(risk+1 pip) >=1.5, spread <=4 points, and all-in reference cost <=1 pip.
Emit at most two intents per America/New_York date; a risk-rejected intent consumes one emission. Emit once per expansion setup ID, both directions allowed, with no pyramiding or concurrent position.

Enter only on the exact next M1 bar, exit at stop or target, otherwise close at the first M1 close at or after 120 elapsed minutes; stop precedes target and target precedes time exit on a shared candle. No overnight position is allowed.

strategies.hypothesis: An unusually large and directionally efficient EURUSD displacement during the fixed 08:30 America/New_York U.S. macro-release window that retains most of its move during a five-minute stabilization period can continue after 08:40 because interpretation and risk transfer may remain incomplete after the first illiquid burst.
strategies.economic_rationale: Scheduled public information arrival repeatedly concentrates volatility and price discovery at 08:30 New York. Waiting through the first ten minutes avoids the initial jump and seeks a larger residual move at no more than one trade per day, with structural 5-15 pip risk and 2.25R reward under conservative 1.0/1.9-pip research costs.
strategies.date_provenance: Prospectively preregistered after explicit user authorization and before implementation or any Strategy 16 development-data access.
frozen_rules: Use validated UTC EURUSD bid M1 OHLCV and America/New_York zoneinfo civil time; Monday-Friday only.
Require every exact M1 bar from 07:30 through 08:39 New York time. Form twelve non-overlapping completed M5 baseline bars over 07:30-08:29, the 08:30-08:34 shock, and the 08:35-08:39 stabilization.

Let P0 be 08:29 close, D be 08:34 close minus P0, A=abs(D), and R be aggregate 08:30-08:34 high-low. Require A>=7 pips, R>=max(2 times baseline median M5 range, baseline linear Q90), A/R>=0.70, and directional adverse excursion<=0.20R.
BUY uses D>0 and SELL D<0. During stabilization no close may cross the 50% retained-displacement level; maximum retracement from the shock close is 40% of A.
The 08:39 close must retain at least 70% of A and reaccelerate at least 0.5 pip beyond the 08:37 close in the shock direction.
Emit at most one intent per New York date at 08:39 and enter only on the exact 08:40 M1 open. A rejected emitted intent consumes the date.
BUY stop is min(stabilization low, P0+0.50A)-0.5 pip; SELL mirrors with max(stabilization high, P0-0.50A)+0.5 pip. At actual entry require 5-15 pips risk.

Target is exactly 2.25 times actual planned risk from entry and remaining reward must be at least 8 pips. Under 1.9-pip stress reference require (reward-1.9)/(risk+1.9)>=1.25, spread<=10 points, and all-in reference cost<=1.9 pips.

Exit a single full position at stop or target, else the first M1 close at or after 10:00 New York, never later than 80 elapsed minutes; stop precedes target and target precedes time exit on a shared candle.

No external release calendar, survey expectation, realized announcement, volume/order flow, future candle, pyramiding, averaging, partial exit, trailing stop, break-even move, concurrent position, or overnight position is permitted. Fail on an open-position M1 gap over 60 seconds.

strategies.hypothesis: A sufficiently large and efficient four-hour London impulse that survives a shallow one-hour pullback may continue into the New York overlap.
strategies.economic_rationale: Holding for hours and requiring a 30-pip minimum reward targets movements large enough that normal-session broker friction is not the main economic determinant.
strategies.date_provenance: Initially registered before development-data access. Corrected on 2026-08-31 with explicit user authorization to add omitted runtime cost/economic defaults; no implementation, archive load, result, or completed experiment existed.
frozen_rules: Use only validated UTC EURUSD bid M1 OHLCV converted with Europe/London zoneinfo; Monday-Friday only.
At 11:00 London require every exact M1 candle from 06:00 through 11:00 and derive completed hourly impulse/pullback composites causally.
Require 06:00-10:00 directional impulse >=25 pips, efficiency >=0.60, 10:00-11:00 pullback <=40% of impulse, and 11:00 close retaining >=80% of impulse.
Enter only at exact next M1 open at 11:01; emit at most one intent per London date and a rejected intent consumes its date.
Use pullback extreme plus one pip as stop; actual risk 12-35 pips; target exactly 2R from actual entry and at least 30 pips reward.
Exit at stop or target, otherwise first M1 close at or after 16:00 London, no later than 300 minutes and never overnight.
Do not use calendars, volume, order flow, future prices, pyramiding, averaging, partial exits, trailing, break-even moves, concurrent positions, or discretionary handling.

frozen_specification.persistence_rationale: A multi-hour impulse and retained reclaim seek residual intraday order-flow adjustment with a planned reward far larger than normal-session friction.
entry_logic: Require every frozen impulse, efficiency, pullback, and reclaim condition at 11:00.
Enter only on the exact next M1 open.

direction_rules: Buy after positive impulse and retained reclaim.
